summary.en-US: A Bitwarden/Vaultwarden-compatible vault where every secret is additionally wrapped to a hardware key -- each use costs a deliberate physical tap.

description.en-US:
Ragewarden stores its vault on any Bitwarden or Vaultwarden server, but adds a second encryption layer on top of the Bitwarden one: every item is wrapped with age to per-recipient stanzas, so a secret can only be opened by a key you hold.

Hardware-backed by design -- recipients can be a YubiKey (PIV), a FIDO2 authenticator (hmac-secret), or a platform WebAuthn PRF credential. Opening an item requires a deliberate physical action on the device; the server never sees plaintext.

Paper recovery -- a 24-word phrase can be enrolled as an additional recipient, so a lost device does not mean a lost vault.

This is the browser client. It talks to the same vault as the ragewarden CLI (rageterm) and Android app (ragedroid), sharing one cross-client recipient registry.
